about: The epistola of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass at Dawn” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Dearly beloved: The goodness and loving-kindness of God our Savior appeared, not by works of justice which we had done, but according to His mercy He saved us, through the laver of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Ghost, Whom He poured forth abundantly upon us through Jesus Christ our Savior, that, justified by His grace, we might become heirs according to the hope of eternal life, in Christ Jesus our Lord.
